brand.name: FINDARO
brand.status: provisional; no usar para registro ni campañas pagadas hasta completar búsqueda legal
brand.positioning: Explorador avanzado de archivos para macOS para personas que necesitan más contexto y control al gestionar archivos.

rules: Dark-first but fully compatible with macOS Light/Dark appearance.
Blue is the primary action color; violet is reserved for AI/smart features; cyan is a restrained information accent.
Do not use glow on every control. Glow is limited to hero/brand moments and focus.
Prioritize scanability, information density and keyboard use over decorative effects.
Do not remove existing functionality, shortcuts or workflows.
